name: Citation Checker
summary: Python tool that verifies references in a paper exist and that author names and years match, using free academic APIs.
description: Command-line Python script that parses .bib, .ris or .txt reference lists, searches Semantic Scholar, CrossRef and OpenAlex, and returns VERIFIED, SUSPICIOUS or NOTFOUND per reference. Built to audit AI-assisted writing, with an offline demo mode and JSON export.
contains: parses title, authors, year and DOI per reference
accepts .bib, .ris and .txt files with automatic format detection
queries Semantic Scholar, CrossRef and OpenAlex (free, no account needed)
offline demo mode (--mock) plus live demos that hit real APIs
roughly 1-2% of real papers may show as NOTFOUND due to indexing gaps
